integrity: The all-parameter result is proved mathematically. A standalone, exact finite-field verifier corroborates selected finite instances, including GF(4). No human or independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite fields of size q at least n, one exact deletion, and codimension-one linear codes only. This bound on the alphabet size is sufficient and no optimality of that condition is claimed. It does not address general smaller alphabets or more deletions.
title: Sharp large-alphabet one-deletion lists for single-parity-check codes
